parsed.why: State layer works: accommodations/hotel anti-discrimination with investigating enforcement body, bias-crime enhancements, visitor-covering care shield, surgery-free documents, ban on panic defence, and measured safest per-capita trans-killing rate. National entry/document regime still caps it.

No facilities ban, 2013 anti-discrimination covering accommodations, hate-crime enhancement, provider-statement marker change; but low-risk grouping is defined as mere non-targeting, no shield law, no X marker, and enforcement/violence data absent.

Most Protective tier with 2022 shield law expressly covering visitors from ban states, gender-identity custody/treatment policy, public-accommodation and service discrimination bans, X markers, hate-crime coverage; no violence data either way.

Strongest local machinery: GENDA accommodations/credit/housing, 2024 constitutional ban, broad shield barring out-of-state enforcement, mandated gender-neutral bathrooms, repealed loitering statute; only LGBTQ-general tolerance polling, no trans-specific violence figures.

Hostile local layer: care ban extended to prisoners with no taper, surgical-only marker change, no gender-identity non-discrimination recourse, official reporting tipline. Below parent; sanctuary cities too thin to offset.
